description: On the table there are small colorful plates (green, blue, and red), a blue scrub sponge, a yellow squeeze bottle, and a pile of plastic utensils to the left. The left hand lifts and steadies the green plate near the center while the right hand first sets the yellow bottle down on the right, then picks up the blue sponge and scrubs across the surface of the green plate with short back-and-forth strokes; the left hand lowers the plate onto the blue plate, the right hand releases the sponge onto the table, and then the right hand picks up the red plate on the right.
